description: Schema contract for RedCap Evolution Factory candidates. This is a governance schema, not a JSON Schema draft file.
identity_rule: Identity-related candidates must not auto-edit active identity.md. They may produce an identity proposal or a no-promote decision with evidence.

minimum_experience_shape.problem_source: Why the issue happened and which previous mechanism failed to catch it.
minimum_experience_shape.solution: What was changed or proposed, and why this option was selected.
minimum_experience_shape.final_effect: What improved after the change, backed by evidence.
